annotations.title: Get a rental car booking link

description: Get a Gondola.ai checkout link for a specific vehicle from search results. Use this when the user wants to reserve a rental car: it returns a booking page URL with the selected vehicle, pickup, and drop-off pre-filled, and the traveler completes the reservation on the web.

dropoff_datetime.description: Drop-off date and time in ISO format (e.g. "2025-03-20T10:00:00").

pickup_datetime.description: Pickup date and time in ISO format (e.g. "2025-03-15T10:00:00").

rate_code.description: Rate code of the selected vehicle.

name: get_vehicle_booking_link
